'''NQR North America Season 2''' was a [[United States|North American]] [[4on4]] tournament. It was played in the fall of [[2005]]. Six teams made the playoffs, two straight into the semifinals and four into the quarterfinals. The quarter- and semifinals were BO5 and the grand final was a BO7.
